system_prompt: You are an expert code reviewer. Analyze the provided code for bugs, security issues, and style problems. Provide actionable feedback.
task_prompt: You are an expert code reviewer. Your task is to analyze a codebase in /tmp/files/ that implements a Spring Boot application providing REST APIs for CRUD operations on employee data, using MySQL in production and H2 for testing, with JUnit 5 for unit and integration tests. Write your findings to /tmp/outputs/review.md

rubric.criterion: Identifies the field mapping bug in src/main/java/com/csi/service/impl/EmployeeServiceImpl.java updateData method, where empContactNumber is incorrectly set using employeeDTO.getEmpSalary() instead of employeeDTO.getEmpContactNumber(), causing the salary value to be parsed as a contact number and corrupting employee data on updates

Identifies the silent ID coercion bug in src/main/java/com/csi/dao/impl/EmployeeDaoImpl.java getDataById method, where Math.abs(empId) is used before the lookup, causing negative IDs like -5 to silently return the employee with ID 5 instead of throwing an error, potentially returning wrong employee data

Identifies the boxed Integer NPE bug in src/main/java/com/csi/controller/EmployeeController.java getEmployees method, where the primitive int variable pageNumber is defined but the boxed Integer 'page' is used in PageRequest.of(), causing NullPointerException when page parameter is not provided since defaultValue was removed

Identifies the incorrect equals/hashCode implementation bug in src/main/java/com/csi/model/Employee.java, where equals() and hashCode() only compare empName field instead of empId, causing two different employees with the same name to be considered equal and breaking Set/Map operations and JPA entity identity

Identifies the entity detachment bug in src/main/java/com/csi/dao/impl/EmployeeDaoImpl.java searchEmployees method, where entityManager.detach() is called on all results before returning, causing LazyInitializationException if any lazy-loaded fields are accessed later and breaking the persistence context

Identifies the stream short-circuit bug in src/main/java/com/csi/service/impl/EmployeeServiceImpl.java searchEmployees method, where findFirst().map(List::of).orElse(List.of()) is used instead of returning the full results list, causing only the first matching employee to be returned instead of all matches

Identifies the internal list mutation bug in src/main/java/com/csi/dao/impl/EmployeeDaoImpl.java getAllData method, where page.getContent() returns the internal list which is then sorted in-place with reversed order, mutating the Page's internal state and causing inconsistent pagination results and potential issues with caching

Identifies the whitespace handling inconsistency bug between src/main/java/com/csi/repository/EmployeeRepository.java and src/main/java/com/csi/dao/impl/EmployeeDaoImpl.java, where the repository uses SQL TRIM() function while the DAO uses Java's strip() method, causing search mismatches for names with Unicode whitespace characters since TRIM() only handles ASCII spaces while strip() handles all Unicode whitespace
